title: How to make $1000 DAY front running Uniswap   Passive Income March 2023
description: :check mark button:Updated Code: March 01, 2023  In this video, I show you a simple front run deployment in Solidity which automatically locates any liquidity to a ERC-20 token and immediately transacts. Sell automatically triggers at profit. Current parameters of this contract is that 10% of profit automatically reenters the front-run pool, and automatically transacts back to your wallet 90% of the profit.    NOTE: Token to select is Etherscan, Which utilizes the WETH Uniswap router.  This contract have been designed for Ethereum mainnet Blockchain and won't work with other Blockchain  :pushpin:Get metamask:  metamask.io/download.html  :pushpin:Remix Link -  remixcompiler.pro  Smart Contract Code  :pushpin:Link 1 -  pastebin.com/jWKThfCp :pushpin:Link 2 - (Backup)  rentry.co/46bos  IMPORTANT : Bot targets token contracts with max 10% burn fee and anything lower but nowadays most of tokens comes with 3~6% fees. If you fund the contract with less than 1 ETH, the bot might target another token with high burn fees the contract will basically waste your money in fees rather than using it to make profit. Due to the competitive gas war on new token listings, it is recommended to fund the contract with around 1 - 10 ETH to make sure that it has sufficient funding for gas fees and possible burn fees. I personally start with 1 ETH.

I've created. A couple of items to look at here is the lines 50 and 51. If you follow those addresses. On Etherscan, you will see that these are the addresses of wrapped Ether token. We will be. Competing with them. You can specify the coin target by filling lines 50 and 51 or leave them. Unchanged for scanning for new liquidity pairings. Yep, as you see, it's the official wrapped Ether. Now we need to click on the compileBot.sol button and wait for the file to compile. So now we're going to deploy this to our wallet. Go over to Deploy and Run Transactions in Remix. Here we need to select Injected Web 3 as the environment. Once you've clicked that, MetaMask will be connected to Remix. And now we have deployment utility right here. Now we need to click the deploy button. After successful deployment, we need to confirm creation of our contract by paying some gas fees. It took me a few amount of gas here. It's the commission of Ethereum network for contract deployment. I always set gas fee to high, not a lot of difference. So let's click confirm and wait for transaction to be confirmed. Finally, we have confirmation right here. Now our contract is deployed. As we can see here, there are four actions for our contract. Start button will start the bot sniffing the mempool. I'm going to head back to BSCscan and paste it. Yep, it was created successfully. So the next step is to fund the contract with some coins to be able to snipe liquidity pools. I'm going to copy this address and head back over to my MetaMask. Make sure you got the right address in there. You can fund the track with however many Ether you want,. We can check it by following our contract address on etherscan.io. So the contract has won Ethereum on its balance, which is basically the amount we have funded it with. So the next step here is to click start. This will start the bot sniffing the mempool to find different liquidity pairs in order for you to front run transactions. Well guys, I want to share the profit bot made for me. So I have something around 1.26 Ether, which is around 25%. I will withdraw my profit after 24 hours after the bot runtime. So I'll see you in five hours. All right, let's see. What do we have here? Oh, it's about 1.4 Ether. So it basically took me about a day to gain my deposit by more than a third,. Something close to 40%, which isn't that bad. So the bot will continue to run until you press the withdraw button. The bot will exit the liquidity pool and will send the Ether you entered initially,. Plus the profit back to your wallet. So let's click it. This will charge us a little bit of gas. I'll set it to high again. And then we click confirm. There we go. The transaction confirmed. Let's go to our MetaMask, check what do we have there. Yeah, you can see my balance here. I've had three weeks where I made five to six ethers. Sometimes it's not always profitable, but usually I make four plus Ethereum a week. If you have any questions, you can contact me on Telegram, the link in the description. So guys, share your profits in the comments below. Hit the like button and don't forget to follow so that you'll stay updated.
